findings.detail: The executing-root check binds the verifier rather than the helper that called it. Consider verified snapshot A and an external helper copy B whose scripts/helper-snapshot is a symlink to A/bundle/scripts/helper-snapshot. Invoking B/scripts/checked-gate through A's exec command passes this check: the verifier resolves into A, although checked-gate and checked_core.py execute from B. B then uses the inherited identity to stamp new receipts as A or accept A's existing receipts. A's inventory never examines B or its symlink. This is a remaining instance of A1. Bind and validate the actual calling entry, including its path components, rather than only the verifier's __file__.
findings.evidence: helper-snapshot:148 compares Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], where __file__ belongs to helper-snapshot. checked-gate:21 and checked-plant:21 load that sibling through runpy without passing their own __file__. With the sibling symlink described above, resolve() returns A's verifier path and verify() inventories only A. checked_core.py:31-50 subsequently returns the inherited HELPER_BUNDLE_IDENTITY without checking the executing core's location. The Bash entry guards likewise invoke the sibling verifier without supplying their own entry path.
findings.title: Uncited: Unenforced trust boundary: a symlinked verifier still permits another helper to inherit producer identity

findings.detail: The link-discovery reference still instructs the agent to invoke the resolved executable directly. Following this example from the calling shell bypasses the required snapshot launcher. Earlier launcher subprocesses do not export their snapshot context back into that shell, so review-scope takes its legacy path and skips bundle verification. Changed snapshot contents can therefore reach link discovery without the required refusal. This is a remaining instance of A3, even when review_scope_bin points into the task-owned snapshot. Replace the direct invocation with the verified launcher, as the updated ledger example does.
findings.evidence: references/reviewers.md:158 defines review_scope_bin as the resolved bundled executable, and line 162 executes it directly. review-until-clean/SKILL.md:46-55 requires every bundled helper invocation through the launcher. review-scope:5-8 verifies only when a HELPER_SNAPSHOT_* or HELPER_BUNDLE_IDENTITY variable exists; a direct invocation from the parent shell normally has none. helper-snapshot.environment changes only the launched child's environment. references/ledger.md:22-23 already uses the verified launcher for its sibling helper example.
findings.title: Uncited: Agent-prose control flow: link discovery still bypasses required snapshot verification
